DM: Ryegrass Mass Note that this is after any harvest e.g. at end of time stamp
DM_RYE_RM: dry matter of Rye species harvested in this time step Note that this is the calculated removal but if 'opt_harvfrin' = False then it may be significantly different to the actual removal which is show by the appropriate yield variable
DM_WEED_RM: dry matter of weed species harvested in this time step; Note that this is the calculated removal but if 'opt_harvfrin' = False then it may be significantly different to the actual removal which is show by the appropriate yield variable
DMH: harvestable dry matter = DMH_RYE + DMH_WEED note that this is before any removal by harvesting
DMH_RYE: harvestable dry matter of rye species includes harvestable fraction of dead HARVFRD note that this is before any removal by harvesting
DMH_WEED: harvestable dry matter of weed specie includes harvestable fraction of dead HARVFRD note that this is before any removal by harvesting
IRR_TARG: irrigation Target fraction of field capacity to fill to also an input variable
IRR_TRIG: irrigation trigger fraction of field capacity at which to start irrigating
IRRIG_DEM: irrigation irrigation demand to field capacity * IRR_TARG
PAW: Profile available water at the time step
RESEEDED: reseeded flag if ==1 then the simulation was reseeded on this day
RYE_YIELD: PRG Yield from rye grass species note that this is the actual amount of material that has been removed
WAFC: Water in non-frozen root zone at field capacity
WAWP: Water in non-frozen root zone at wilting point
WEED_YIELD: PRG Yield from weed other species note that this is the actual amount of material that has been removed
YIELD: PRG Yield sum of YIELD_RYE and YIELD_WEED
